conceptual_change: Incorporate a time-based volatility filter that pauses trade execution if the ATR_14 value exceeds the 20-period moving average of ATR by more than 1.5 standard deviations, replacing the previous proposed dynamic position sizing to prevent entry during high-volatility regime shifts.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous attempt at dynamic position sizing was rejected due to implementation complexity in the engine. Shifting the strategy to an execution filter based on existing ATR parameters avoids engine-level architectural changes while addressing the drawdown severity caused by volatility spikes.
